protectedFixes.description: Known movement identity survives active-to-completed evidence; exact approved art falls back to governed anatomy and never treats an ambiguous row ID as canonical identity.
Self-coached athletes receive free governed Swap authority.
The first persisted SetLog locks movement identity replacement.
Coach Coming Up opens the exact Session Workspace in athlete Programming Manager context.
Relationship-scoped MeetPlan context remains visible as Meet Day across Coach Home, Athlete Hub, and Calendar without replacing Session behavior.
Completed Session recap retains the rich Plan / Compare renderer.
Accessory strength metrics use e10RM while Core and Core Variant use e1RM.
Individual Accessory artwork uses focused canonical muscle-region PNGs.
Last exposure and Movement History remain governed by exact canonical identity.
Typed historical Ledger identity and reconstructed Journey evidence remain visible.
The selected local display unit controls every mobile weight surface.
Programming Manager owns the consolidated Week workspace without redundant Week Detail.
Machine and cable movements retain the required equipment-selection path.
Session Workspace uses one authoritative app-shell presentation boundary.
The active Program Timeline control launches the canonical stable-ID route from Athlete Training Hub.
Session Workspace Add Accessory mounts the canonical guided muscle-first discovery flow rather than the substitution-only flat picker.
Completed accessory recaps preserve exact-equipment progression while explicitly separating governed same-family related-equipment context on first exact exposure.
Coach Session Review presentation state resets on canonical Session identity or visit changes while preserving same-review child navigation continuity.
Compact Logger actions retain equipment/edit/swap authority, true inline title suffix and bodyweight zero-load edit.
Whole-catalog aliases, prefixes, bounded typos, muscle/equipment discovery and stale-request isolation in Workspace and Hot Swap.
Hide known-empty history, retain any-history navigation and distinct unresolved reads without borrowing equipment performance.
Shared survey retains readiness controls, keyboard behavior, saved callbacks, skip path and busy guards.
Earned Core/accessory recognition remains queued through the actual accepted-sheet and rest-picker handoff; original delayed reservation fails the route-callback regression.
Fresh mobile sign-in reads authenticated canonical account identity before account-scoped workspaces or queues; missing login/settings IDs cannot make valid coach workspaces inaccessible.

releaseHoldbacks.reason: Retain already-shipped Cable selection and governed catalog until separately validated matching backend releases. Preserve the zero-load repair and every owner-approved compact Logger change as identical exact patches on both shipped and DEV sources; no unrelated candidate change is allowed.

publicationProgression.ownerInstruction: Okay, forget about the canonical education and guidance. I don't give a fuck. Just, just, okay, update TestFlight to be up to date, please. And then after that, I want you to do a final go no-go against production. Give me a go or no-go to start building, and then I will do the build. You do not have that right to do the build. I will do it and monitor the build.
publicationProgression.reason: Publish the exact reviewed cumulative source and actual human-approved art/crops; preserve historical pins, compatibility identity and deferred Cable backend boundary.

<SessionV3Header title={workout.label || 'Training Session'} subtitle={[workout.week_number ? `W${workout.week_number}` : null, workout.date ? new Date(`${workout.date.slice(0, 10)}T12:00:00Z`).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' }) : null].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')} active={isActiveSession} preview={isCoachAthletePreview ? athlete.name : null} inset={insets.top}
        logged={loggedSets} total={plannedSets} startedAt={workout.started_at}
        onBack={() => { if (isPreSession && focusedMovementKey) { setFocusedMovementKey(null); setExpandedCoreDetails({}); setExpandedCompletedMovements({}); } else handleBackToTrainingHub(); }}
